items.title: Generate review-assurance guidance from the canonical gate predicate
items.context: Use the same canonical review-assurance/DONE-closure source of truth used by the gate. The output must include reason code, current material binding, legal writer, fallback eligibility, and cannot-auto-sign explanation.
items.userSees: "Review assurance required: reason=first-round-problems, materialHash=<sha>, storyFilesHash=<sha>, legal writers=independent reviewer lanes or host quorum; fallback eligibility=<eligible/not eligible>; owner/main cannot auto-sign reviewer pass, finding resolution, delivery check, host verdict, or degraded fallback evidence."

happy.desc: A fixture with >=2 countable first-round findings and high-risk lifecycle work prints canonical review-assurance guidance before DONE.

edge.desc: Fallback guidance is printed only when canonical status says degraded-single-host fallback is eligible.

adversarial.desc: Display-only code cannot satisfy or weaken the DONE review-assurance gate and cannot auto-write verdict/fallback evidence.

items.title: Surface review assurance before DONE at required command surfaces
items.context: Make review-assurance requirements visible at required first implementation surfaces: review finding or first-round summary, review_escalation_status, story_advance --phase=TEST as advisory, session_brief/next, and done_prepare/done_prepare --dryRun.
items.userSees: "Before DONE: review assurance required for this story. Run lattice review_escalation_status --storyId=<id>; then get independent reviewer/host evidence or approved fallback before DONE. This is advisory at TEST entry and does not block TEST."

happy.desc: session_brief/next and done_prepare --dryRun surface the requirement for a triggered story before DONE.

edge.desc: story_advance --phase=TEST surfaces review assurance as advisory and does not convert it into a TEST gate.

adversarial.desc: Machine-readable output remains parseable for every touched surface and process-fact contract tests pass.

items.title: Classify done_prepare blockers with safe next-command recipes
items.context: Implement M4 blocker grouping for required gate, missing evidence, generated metadata, stale material, and cannot-auto-sign cases. The guidance must separate legal writer paths from owner-only commands.
items.userSees: done_prepare blockers are grouped by action type and explain whether the agent can run a command or must ask a reviewer/host/human-approved fallback path.

happy.desc: done_prepare classifies a missing review assurance blocker and prints canonical next-command guidance.

edge.desc: Generated metadata blockers are not allowed to suggest committing unrelated user changes.

adversarial.desc: Cannot-auto-sign guidance appears for host verdicts, degraded fallback, reviewer evidence, and delivery checks where applicable.
